thoughts: The current layout suffers from redundant headlines and a standard SaaS-tier presentation that lacks the gravitas of a high-stakes infrastructure project. Most critically, the third CTA ('Connect with a Strategist') fails accessibility tests with nearly invisible contrast against the dark background. By transitioning to a BLUEPRINT layout strategy, we emphasize the 'digital and physical architecture' mentioned in the copy. This approach uses technical line-work, improved color hierarchy, and integrated social proof (testimonials) and technical specs (evidence items) to transform a pricing table into a strategic roadmap.
